stages.name: Bounded scoped deterministic retrieval
stages.evidence: Native/Python, JVM, storage fixtures, physical phone, lint/Detekt/APK and integrity checks

stages.name: Review and freeze development annotations
stages.prerequisite: 360 remaining annotation reviews plus reviewed scenario/duplicate families; five annotations approved, no fitting partitions frozen

stages.name: Train and calibrate classifier
stages.prerequisite: Stage 2 annotation/family freeze plus 100 calibration and 50 selection requests; configuration/quotas frozen in protocol, no v15 model fit

stages.name: Fresh independent evaluation
stages.prerequisite: Stage 3 quality gates and candidate/parser/threshold/protocol freeze, then 150 new requests with separate author/reviewer

stages.name: Repository and actual app validation
stages.completed_substage: Current deterministic app passed JVM/Python/integrity/lint/Detekt/APKs and 12 isolated phone tests; CI updated
stages.prerequisite: Final classifier/evaluation outcome and observed supported-API CI matrix; no Android ML validation claimed

stages.name: Android ML benchmark
stages.prerequisite: Passing offline quality gates; no ML benchmark build or latency/PSS/battery result yet
